panels.title: Event-loop lag
panels.description: nodejs_eventloop_lag_seconds -- free via collectDefaultMetrics() (metrics-prom.ts), enabled for every daemon. A more direct Node.js saturation/blocking signal than CPU% alone.

panels.title: Role-assignment wait time (p95)
panels.description: dvconf_role_assignment_wait_seconds{service,result} -- waitForRoleAssignment()'s polling loop, packages/shared/src/chain/role-assignment.ts. Emitted by all 4 daemon roles (cp-daemon, relay, signaling, validator-daemon all call waitForRoleAssignment() at startup, confirmed by grep -- not role-restricted, despite an earlier version of this panel's description claiming otherwise).

panels.title: Role-assignment wait outcome rate
panels.description: rate(dvconf_role_assignment_wait_seconds_count) by result -- the success-vs-timeout SPLIT the p95-only panel above can't show (a flat p95 looks the same whether everything succeeds slowly or half of it times out).

panels.title: Chain tx latency by method
panels.description: dvconf_chain_tx_duration_seconds{service,method} -- executeWithRetry() calls, packages/shared/src/chain/tx.ts. Emitted by all 4 daemon roles.

panels.title: Chain event-poll duration
panels.description: dvconf_chain_poll_duration_seconds{service,module} -- EventPoller.pollOnce wall-clock, packages/shared/src/chain/events.ts.

panels.title: Chain tx retry rate by method
panels.description: dvconf_chain_tx_retries_total{service,method} -- executeWithRetry() retry attempts, packages/shared/src/chain/tx.ts. A rising rate here precedes actual tx failures.

panels.title: Chain events processed rate
panels.description: dvconf_chain_events_processed_total{service,module} -- EventPoller throughput, packages/shared/src/chain/events.ts (poll DURATION is the panel above; this is poll THROUGHPUT).

panels.title: RTT + jitter (relay)
panels.description: dvconf_rtc_rtt_ms / dvconf_rtc_jitter_ms{direction} -- server-observed mediasoup RTP-stream stats, apps/relay/src/signaling/index.ts. Only emitted by relay.

panels.title: Active sessions + room count
panels.description: dvconf_relay_active_sessions / dvconf_relay_room_count -- apps/relay/src's SFU worker-side session/room gauges. Only populated for relay.

panels.title: Bytes forwarded + mediasoup worker deaths
panels.description: rate(dvconf_relay_bytes_forwarded_total) and rate(dvconf_relay_worker_died_total) -- the latter is a hard-failure signal (a mediasoup child worker process exited). Only populated for relay.

panels.title: mediasoup worker resource usage
panels.description: dvconf_relay_worker_ru_{utime,stime}_ms / ru_maxrss_kb -- per mediasoup child-worker getrusage() sample. Only populated for relay.

panels.title: Failover events + duration by phase
panels.description: rate(dvconf_failover_events_total) and dvconf_failover_duration_seconds by phase -- relay standby/promotion failover path. Only populated for relay.
